title: My game LiftLine so far! Vibe coded with Opus 5.5
author: Manifesto-Engine
selftext: All assets,visuals,audio,etc  are made in house via code + blender. Over 12Billion tokens so far over the span of a week or two? I am using the Godot Engine currently with a custom engine in the works, Currently this is an offline game but with plans to include MP with the Open World mode. There's a lot of features, stuff going on so if you have any questions feel free to ask I will explain what stuff does. This is a game I hope others will enjoy once I start releasing public play builds and eventually the MP portion. thank you!  :D

comments.author: SeasawPhilosopher
comments.body: Don’t show me the character select before you’ve even gotten me interested in the gameplay hook. You lost me early OP
